messages:
Anna (CS): Hey team — kicking off WillowBend onboarding. Quick sync tomorrow? They want a small pilot in ~3 weeks. Primary goals: embed Redwood text API into support UI, surface KB embeddings, and hit p99 chat latency <=200ms. Priya is the PM (cc @Priya). Renewal procurement window opens in ~60 days so we should capture early success signals. Can owners volunteer for integration, evals, and enablement? :spiral_calendar:

Mike (Solutions): I can own the integration + dev checklist first 2 weeks. Need to confirm model variant & token budget. Proposed milestones:
- Week0: access + sample data
- Week1: prototype endpoint + smoke tests
- Week2: embed retrieval + basic evals

Jordan (Eng): I'll take runtime/configs + rollout. Recommend canary on Dedicated=false first, 48h soak. I'll size batch/kv caching based on expected qps. Quick question: any need for reserved capacity for pilot? @Mike

Sara (Enablement): I'll run enablement + training for their CS team. Plan: 90m hands-on session, short runbook, and FAQ doc. Need two WillowBend power users to join training and an SLO sign-off owner.

Priya (WillowBend): Thanks — I can get Raj (infra) and Lina (support lead) on the calendar. 3-week pilot sounds good. Success criteria from our side: 1) 60% reduction in average handle time for support flows using suggestions, 2) search hits (embeddings) precision > 0.7, 3) low variance in response times. We'll provide sample transcripts and KB export by EOD tomorrow.

Anna (CS): Great — capture: integration owner: Mike (Solutions) / ETA prototype by Day7; runtime/rollout: Jordan (Eng) / canary Day14-16; enablement: Sara / training Day18. Risk: procurement talk may force a pause at pilot end — we'll capture adoption metrics weekly. I'll draft a one-pager and share in #customer-success.

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: "WillowBend Onboarding Kickoff" tomorrow 10:00am PT — invite includes Priya, Raj, Lina, Mike, Jordan, Sara.

Mike (Solutions): Quick note on tokens/costs: estimate ~120k tokens/week for pilot if we do full session transcripts + embeddings. Will propose a lightweight sampling plan if cost becomes a blocker.

Jordan (Eng): Action items I need from Priya: typical session length distribution, peak qps estimate, and whether PII is scrubbed. If PII present, we'll route through Private deployment checklist.

Priya (WillowBend): I'll send session distribution and confirm data scrub. Also looping in Lina for power users. Thanks all — excited to get going. :rocket:

Anna (CS): Closing summary:
```
Action items:
- Mike: prototype endpoint + smoke tests (due Day7)
- Jordan: runtime canary plan + sizing (due Day10)
- Sara: training materials + schedule (due Day14)
- Priya: data export + session stats (tomorrow EOD)
- Anna: one-pager + weekly adoption dashboard (Day2)
```
I'll post the one-pager and a shared tracking doc after the kickoff. If anyone wants to swap owners ping me. :thumbsup:
